description: A PET_Type object describes one task of a tightly integrated parallel job.

attributes.name: id
description: The pe task id. It is unique per job.

attributes.name: name
description: The name of this parallel environment task, used in the job's output file names and in accounting. Defaults to `petask`.

attributes.name: status
description: Status of the pe job, see defines in libs/gdi/sge_jobL.h.

attributes.name: granted_destin_identifier_list
description: Contains one entry specifying the queue the pe task runs in.

attributes.name: pid
description: Pid of a running pe task (process group id)

attributes.name: osjobid
description: OS jobid / additional group id of a running pe task.

attributes.name: systemd_scope
description: In case a pe task is started in a systemd scope, this is the
scope unit name.
Only used in sge_execd, it is set during the startup phase of the
pe task.

attributes.name: usage_collection
description: Usage collection mode of a pe task.
One of 0 (FALSE), 1 (PDC), 2 (HYBRID), 3 (TRUE).

attributes.name: usage
description: Usage list of a running/just finished pe task.

attributes.name: scaled_usage
description: Scaled usage list of a running/just finished pe task.

attributes.name: reported_usage
description: Used in reporting of long running jobs:
An intermediate usage record is written around midnight every day,
the usage already reported so far is stored in the PET_reported_usage list

attributes.name: previous_usage
description: In case a petask is re-run (@todo is this ever done?) the usage of the previous run.

attributes.name: submission_time
description: Submission time of a task (when qrsh -inherit was called) in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: start_time
description: Start time of the petask in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: end_time
description: End time of the petask in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: cwd
description: Path to the petask's current working directory.
If not set, the cwd from the ja task is inherited.

attributes.name: path_aliases
description: Path alias list for the petask.

attributes.name: environment
description: Environment variables to be set when executing the job (qrsh inherit -v).
They will overwrite inherited variables from the ja task.

attributes.name: do_contact
description: Used in limit enforcement to remember whether to contact the host where a task is running.
Is set to false when the host is down/unknown.

attributes.name: cred
description: Used with the TLS encryption to transport the credentials
from qrsh to the sge_execd, which will store it in the pe_task's active_jobs directory.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
